decision: Choose curated templates, an open gallery, or a hybrid for the onboarding library
problem: Administrators need trustworthy starting points without evaluating an unbounded catalog

evidence.claim: New administrators abandon setup when they cannot distinguish supported templates

options.name: Hybrid
options.userValue: Curated default with clearly separated community discovery

hypothesis.statement: A curated default plus separated community gallery improves first-session success without reducing discovery.
hypothesis.successMeasure: 10% higher completed setup with no increase in trust-related support cases
hypothesis.failureThreshold: Less than 3% completion lift or more than 1% trust-case increase

validationPlan.method: Prototype test followed by bounded A/B rollout
validationPlan.budget: Two design weeks and one engineering week
validationPlan.decisionRule: Advance only if the success measure clears and the failure threshold does not trigger
